title: feat(role/python): add Python installation role using uv
description:
## Summary

- Adds a new `python` role that installs one or more Python versions into `/opt/python/{version}/` using [uv](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv)
- Optionally sets a default Python version via the Linux alternatives system (`/usr/local/bin/python` and `/usr/local/bin/python3`)
- Installs uv itself from GitHub releases if not already present (version pinnable via `python_uv_version`)
- Follows the same patterns and conventions as the existing `r` role

## Platform support

Tested with molecule across all supported platforms:
- Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04
- Debian 12, 13
- Rocky Linux 9, 10
- openSUSE Leap 15

## Test plan

- [x] `just check` passes (ansible-lint production profile)
- [x] `just test python` passes on all 7 platforms (converge, idempotence, verify)

Closes #3

title: feat(role/r): add R installation role with multi-platform support
description:
## Summary

- Adds the `r` role for installing R versions from Posit pre-built binaries (r-builds CDN)
- Supports Debian/Ubuntu, RHEL 9+/Rocky Linux, and SUSE/openSUSE platforms
- Registers each installed version with the Linux alternatives system; optionally sets a default via `/usr/local/bin/R` and `/usr/local/bin/Rscript`
- Adds project tooling: `Justfile`, `ansible.cfg`, `requirements.yml`, molecule test infrastructure
- Molecule tests validated across 7 platforms: ubuntu2204, ubuntu2404, debian12, debian13, rockylinux9, rockylinux10, opensuseleap15

Closes #2

## Key design decisions

- `r_version_default` defaults to `""` — no default symlink is created unless explicitly requested, leaving any existing system R untouched
- Per-version registration uses `community.general.alternatives` (`state: present`, `priority: 1`) with names `local-R` and `local-Rscript`; `set_default.yml` flips to `state: selected` only when `r_version_default` is set
- RHEL 8 deferred to #7 (requires Python 3.9 workaround for ansible-core 2.20)
- RPM signature verification deferred to #8

## Related issues

- #7 — Add RHEL 8 to the r role test matrix
- #8 — Investigate GPG signing of Posit r-builds RPMs
- #9 — Add input validation for r_versions
- #10 — Move gfortran dependency into role (currently in molecule prepare)
- #11 — Add checksum verification for downloaded packages
- #12 — Allow opt-out of EPEL/CRB repository configuration

## Test plan

- [x] `just check` passes (ansible-lint, production profile, no violations)
- [x] `just test r` passes all 7 molecule platforms
- [x] `just build` produces a valid collection artifact

title: Add posit.team collection with utility roles and orchestration playbook
description:
## Summary

Initial implementation of the `posit.team` Ansible collection — shared utility roles for installing Posit products, plus an orchestration playbook that deploys all three products in dependency order.

### Utility roles

| Role | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `posit.team.install` | OS-abstracted package install via Cloudsmith (default) or CDN, with version pinning (dpkg hold / dnf versionlock / zypper lock) |
| `posit.team.license` | License activation via `.lic` file (recommended) or key string. `no_log` on key activation. |
| `posit.team.service` | systemd management with port-based health check |
| `posit.team.discover_runtimes` | Auto-scan `/opt/R/`, `/opt/python/`, `/opt/quarto/` and set facts for product roles |
| `posit.team.ppm_bootstrap` | Create CRAN, PyPI, Bioconductor repos via `rspm` CLI after PPM install |

### Orchestration playbook (`playbooks/posit-team.yml`)

Deploys Posit Team in dependency order: prerequisites → Package Manager → Connect → Workbench.

- Each product toggleable via `posit_deploy_*` boolean
- PPM URL auto-propagates to Connect (R + Python package repos) and Workbench (CRAN repos + pip index)
- PPM host skips R/Python/Quarto prereqs (doesn't need them)
- Post-deploy smoke test pings each product's health endpoint
- Example inventory with single-server and multi-server layouts

### Dependencies

- `posit.tools >= 0.2.0` (cloudsmith, CDN download module, R/Python/Quarto installation)

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify install role works on Ubuntu, RHEL, SLES
- [ ] Verify version pinning holds packages after install
- [ ] Verify license file copy and key activation
- [ ] Verify discover_runtimes finds standard posit.tools installations
- [ ] Verify ppm_bootstrap creates repos idempotently
- [ ] Verify smoke test catches failed services
- [ ] Full playbook run: single-server all-products deployment
